headline: New York Enacts Five-Year Ban on AI-Powered Internet Connected Toys
summary: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed legislation implementing a five-year ban on the manufacture and sale of toys powered by AI chatbots and internet-connected conversational features for children.
why: State-level regulatory bans on specific technology products force manufacturers and toy companies to alter product lines and compliance strategies within the jurisdiction.

impacts.name: Toy Manufacturing Sector
impacts.why: A state ban on AI-enabled toys restricts market access for relevant manufacturers.
